headline: Anthropic reportedly sets its IPO price range, N-able pulls N-central offline after a 33 zero-day dump, UFC 334 fight week begins, and Verstappen wants answers before Vegas.

upcoming.what: SpaceX Starship Flight 15 target date, attempting ship and booster catches; pending FAA approval (time TBC)
UFC 334, Madison Square Garden: Gane vs Hokit (heavyweight title) and Harrison vs Nunes. Prelims 00:00, main card 02:00 Sun 15 Nov Irish time
Leonid meteor shower peak; best from about 01:00 to dawn, with little moonlight to spoil it
GTA 6 launches on PS5 and Xbox Series X/S
Polaris 40, Southampton: Tonon vs McNally. UFC Doha: Prochazka vs Stirling
F1 Las Vegas GP, lights out around 04:00 Irish time (TBC)

items.headline: Anthropic reportedly sets an IPO price range
items.summary: An updated filing reportedly puts the range at $70-78 a share for roughly 825M shares, valuing the company around $1.3-1.4 trillion ahead of its Nasdaq debut as ANT. Figures come via aggregators, so treat them as provisional.

items.headline: N-able takes N-central offline after 33 alleged zero-days go public
items.summary: The RMM vendor pulled its hosted platform after a dump of claimed vulnerabilities; it says it has seen no active exploitation and is working on a fix. A big deal for MSPs and the networks they manage.

items.headline: Google shows off two new eighth-gen TPU variants
items.summary: The TPU 8tx targets secure and regulated workloads, while the 8i Max is aimed at long-context AI with reportedly double the memory bandwidth. No availability date yet.

items.headline: DeepMind AI formally verifies Signal's crypto at the binary level
items.summary: Google DeepMind says its AlphaProof Code system machine-checked key guarantees of the Signal protocol in compiled code, generating millions of lines of proof in about four weeks.

items.headline: Quiet otherwise: Starship still pointed at Friday
items.summary: No fresh word on FAA sign-off for Starship Flight 15's dual-catch attempt, which remains targeted for 13 November.

items.headline: Tonight in Cavan: dark skies, check the cloud
items.summary: The Moon is a thin crescent just past new and sets early, so after about 18:30 it's properly dark; the limiting factor is cloud. A live cloud forecast couldn't be retrieved this morning, so check Met Éireann before heading out. Verdict: mixed, best window 19:00-midnight if it clears.

items.headline: GTA 6 is eight days out
items.summary: Preloads went live yesterday ahead of the 19 November launch on PS5 and Xbox Series X/S.

items.headline: Watchlist: still quiet
items.summary: Nothing new in the last 48 hours on The Witcher 4 (still targeting 2028), Cyberpunk 2, Witcher 3 or Borderlands.

items.headline: Quiet week before Polaris 40
items.summary: No major results since The Crown; next up is Polaris 40 in Southampton on 21 November, headlined by Garry Tonon vs McNally.

items.headline: UFC 334 fight week: Gane vs Hokit at MSG
items.summary: Gane defends heavyweight gold against Hokit on Saturday, with Harrison vs Nunes as co-main. Main card 02:00 Sunday Irish time; no Irish or UK fighters on the main card.

items.headline: Verstappen demands an investigation
items.summary: Verstappen is pushing for answers both inside Red Bull and over F1's season-finale decision, as the FIA reaffirms the year will finish in Qatar and Abu Dhabi. Antonelli leads the standings on 390 to Verstappen's 279.

items.headline: Calls for FIA action after Norris near-miss
items.summary: An incident that nearly injured Lando Norris has prompted calls for the FIA to step in on safety.

items.headline: Corvette Racing clinch the WEC LMGT3 title
items.summary: Corvette wrapped up the 2026 LMGT3 world championship at the season finale.
